title: Coordinator state for the next session
role: Coordinator: plans, writes prompts for other sessions, reviews their PRs, merges. Does not write feature code itself (small test or docs fixes are fine).
owner_rules: Owner writes Russian, takes part minimally (AGENTS.md 'Owner And Questions'); design questions are decided by the agent and reported, or go to another session.
Always tell the owner about open questions: one line each, settled how, or a yes/no question with a recommendation; explain product questions in plain words (what a reader of the site notices).
Coordinator may merge docs and test PRs itself after review and green CI.

Sessions: the coordinator hands out prompts to local Claude Code sessions itself (ListAgents, SendMessage with notify_when_idle) and the owner does not duplicate them (agreed 2026-10-23 after the same prompts ran twice). Never push or open a PR for a peer whose push was blocked in its own session: the owner tells that session directly. Close finished sessions on the owner's request (kill the claude process; pids from /tmp/cc-socks/<pid>.sock).

Deploy also prunes articles older than RETENTION_DAYS=800 (scripts/deploy_prod.sh:241), not only nightly db-maintenance; until 016 phase 1 (archive before prune) every deploy deletes the oldest articles.
Code PRs (behavior or move-only refactors) and deploy files: merge only with the owner's yes.
Tags v0.1.NNN trigger deploy: only on the owner's request. Before a tag check that no nightly job runs (systemctl is-active ai-news-daily-fetch.service ai-news-daily-digest.service).
Prod (ssh ai-news) is read-only; any write needs the owner's yes for that action. When the owner asks to 'restart everything', fetch AND digest+signals of the affected day are meant.

Allow-listed commands run alone, nothing chained: `gh pr merge N --merge`; tags as `git tag -a vX <sha> -m ...` then `git push origin vX` from the main folder root. Chained or other forms are blocked by auto mode. Check .claude/settings.local.json before asking the owner for a permission.

Work in git worktrees from origin/master; no git writes in the main folder except tags (it may lag behind master; the owner pulls). venv1 is editable on the main folder: in a worktree run checks with PYTHONPATH=src ../AI_PARSER/venv1/bin/...
Docs-only PRs skip the full gate (say so in the PR). Merge with gh pr merge --merge.
Prompts for other sessions: untracked in docs/ while active, then copied to docs/archive/2026-10/ in a docs PR and the untracked copy removed.

The owner saves the Claude limit: some prompts run on other models (GPT-6-Luna, DeepSeek V4-Pro, Sonnet). Write them step by step (worktree path, branch, exact edits, checks, commit message, full gh pr create, report fields) and verify every report against the diff and CI yourself.
Review of a move-only PR: compare every moved top-level definition with the old file (ast.get_source_segment), list deleted names and check they were dead, check test patch targets.
zsh: write ${VAR} before ':' in refspecs ($SHA:refs is read as a modifier). A stacked PR is not retargeted when the base branch stays on GitHub: gh pr edit N --base master.
